# 0032. The log-tag registry is regenerated by tag literal

**Date:** 2026-08-25 (`login.*` sweep), 2026-09-05 (`auth.forgot_password`), 2026-09-13 (Wave cadence tags gone), 2026-09-29 (`AUTH-CHANGEPW`) · **Rules file:** `.claude/rules/error-handling.md`

## Context
The registry's regeneration paragraph once claimed there were exactly four `tag:` sites and named two
(`IMG-SAVE`/`IMG-SHARE`) that are positional, not named. Following it as written missed seven tags, so
it now lists the SHAPES that hide a tag from a `logger.warn('` grep instead of counting sites.

Tag history: six `login.*` dotted-lowercase tags, in no registry at all, were replaced by
`AUTH-SIGNIN` / `AUTH-PREFILL` on 2026-08-25; until then the whole sign-in path was invisible to a
search by tag. That sweep missed `auth.forgot_password`, which survived until 2026-09-05 and is
`AUTH-RESET` now. The same pass gave the four `auth_service.dart` `completeAccountSetup:` labels the
`AUTH-SETUP` tag (they carried none; one is the breadcrumb for `AuthFailureStartingPasswordReused`).
`AUTH-SETUP` also covers `resumeAfterSignUp`, named for the sign-up flow P4c deleted.
`AUTH-CHANGEPW` arrived with the admin password reset (2026-09-29). `EMP-SAVE` went when the employee
save path moved under `EMP-CREATE`; `EMP-REVOKE` retired with P4c (`EMP-DELETE` replaced it);
`WAVE-SCHED` / `WAVE-SCHEDULE` left the app with the Wave import cadence (2026-09-13; they survive only
in `functions/wave/`).

The save pipeline's photo cleanup once took a `tag:` parameter, lost its second caller when the
whole-job delete moved server-side, and the parameter then hid `APPT-SAVE` from the grep for the sake
of a single possible value.

## Decision
Regenerate the registry by grepping `lib/` for each TAG LITERAL, covering the listed shapes. A `tag:`
parameter is justified only where its helper has more than one caller.

## Consequences
Don't re-add a retired tag from an older copy of the list, and don't go back to counting sites.
